profile.headline: Senior Software Consultant at The Home Depot
profile.summary:
•Senior Consultant/Project Manager/Application Developer with proven track record of success in multiple industries, most recently Retail Supply Chain and Human Resource.
•Specializing in development of high quality automation solutions scalable to enterprise technology platforms.
•Applications feature performance tuned SQL and creative data-management techniques enabling excellent response time against large databases as well as distributed front-end/back-end database configuration.
•Lots of experience using large relational databases (60+ million rows)
•Highly skilled data integration professional with extensive ODBC experience in conjunction with Oracle, SQL Server, DB2
•Will deliver proof of concept and volume testing to ensure project feasibility and scope.

Specialties: Developing complex MS Access automation solutions utilizing heavy Visual Basic and ODBC connectivity. Very strong Executive Reporting and Form presentation skills. Excellent communication and relationship building skills.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
• OVERVIEW
I work with Home Depot Directors, Senior Managers, and Analysts to develop quality Supply Chain solutions. Demonstrate feasibility, proof of concept, and cost effectiveness. Ensure enterprise scalability.

Recent accomplishments...

• EXECUTIVE LEVEL
Developed complex Pilot Forecasting tool to support major transportation cost savings project. Tool currently is in use for 12+ DC's pending completion of enterprise solution. Tool utilizes complex lead-time, review-time parameters and algorithms against extremely large volumes of data. Automated scheduling provides data for transportation/Logistics by 5AM each morning. 

Developed a seasonal "cook book" ordering tool which accurately projects ordering requirements for all seasonal categories of merchandise. Because import ordering has such a long lead-time, this tool assisted Home Depot in maintaining a 99% in-stock rate for items that could only be ordered 1X per year and months in advance.

Developed corporate level Ad/Promotional tool which assisted senior management in maintaining inventory levels and ordering requirements during special promotional events year around. In-Stock data was real time corporate wide for Senior level reporting, 

Developed Home Depot’s Corporate “In Stock” reporting system used by Senior Management to identify inventory issues across a wide range of metrics. Enables complete drill-down functionality through all organizational and functional levels. 

• ANALYST LEVEL
Developed Order Simulation tools which enable Analysts and Managers to accurately estimate order levels and reduce errors across areas of functional responsibility. Quote: “...adds a whole level of credibility to our order estimates and allows the analysts the ability to know where best to focus their efforts, or invest in inventory...”

• MY COMMITMENT
To bring my passion for data solutions to every client and provide solutions beyond the expectation.
